audit_scope: Static upstream source and license inspection only. No upstream code built or executed, no GPU compatibility test, no vendored upstream source in this repository.
recommended_stack: Shared small graph planner, custom observation/belief/candidate layer, and an adapted compact CleanRL-style PPO implementation if using variable-duration macro-actions. SB3 remains a maintained reference or fixed-tick alternative. Unreal simulator transport is not yet selected.

code_resources.license_note: MIT text plus paper-citation request; GitHub SPDX result is NOASSERTION. Retain all applicable notices.
code_resources.recommendation: Optional periodic predictor only; do not import the whole ROS stack.
risks: Fixed weekly frequency bank requires explicit simulation time scaling or configuration.
estimate() alone is not the complete 2017 persistence model or VOI policy.
Static inspection identified empty-input indexing and allocation/deallocation mismatch in helper paths; validate and harden before execution.
POSIX timer dependency requires portability review.

code_resources.license_note: Basic PPO covered by MIT terms; repository includes third-party notices and GitHub reports NOASSERTION.
code_resources.recommendation: Preferred small reference for a duration-aware macro-action PPO adaptation; preserve license and identify modifications.
risks: Inspected project pins PyTorch 2.4.1 and Python <3.11; do not adopt unchanged for the proposed RTX 5090.
Basic script uses constant per-transition discount and merges termination/truncation in its bootstrap handling.
Needs explicit simulator bridge and candidate-action masking.

code_resources.recommendation: Maintained PPO reference; usable standard implementation for fixed-duration decision ticks. Variable-duration support requires deliberate rollout/return changes.
risks: Per-transition gamma and timeout-bootstrap paths assume constant step discount.
Inspected dependencies include Python >=3.10 and PyTorch >=2.8; actual deployment compatibility not tested.

code_resources.license_note: No explicit license grant found in inspected archive. Do not vendor without permission or clarified licensing.
code_resources.recommendation: Implement a small graph shortest-path planner independently; reference D* Lite conceptually or implement its published algorithm later.

code_resources.license_note: Unreal Engine EULA; GitHub NOASSERTION. Do not redistribute engine source as project code.
code_resources.recommendation: Use the simulator and controlled sensing; choose native trainer versus external Python integration only after checking existing team code.
risks: Experimental integration; not an automatic SB3/CleanRL bridge.
Training callbacks can reset agents and accidentally destroy cross-task memory.
No documented per-transition duration discount was found in inspected PPO settings.

implementation_gates: No hidden global passage state in actor, critic, action masks, candidate features, route costs or early-failure callbacks.
Sequence memory survives intermediate goals and policy-update callbacks; terminate only at the defined sequence boundary.
Initial scene changes occur between tasks only. Do not decay a known within-task state as if the scene were continuously changing.
Use fixed-duration decisions or duration-aware reward accumulation, discounting and GAE; adding a time penalty alone is insufficient.
Distinguish task-defined budget exhaustion from an artificial training time-limit truncation before deciding whether to bootstrap.
Respect licenses and retain notices when actually copying source. Publicly downloadable code without a license is not automatically reusable.
Validate GPU/OS/toolchain and simulator throughput before committing to five independent full training runs.
